skill.summary: convert audio files into audio-driven videos with this skill. Works with MP3, WAV, AAC, M4A files up to 200MB. podcasters, musicians, content creators use it...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of video-a2e.
- Convert MP3, WAV, AAC, or M4A audio (up to 200MB) into 1080p MP4 videos.
- Fast cloud GPU processing (30–60 seconds typical).
- Simple credit and session system: supports anonymous and registered users.
- Upload, describe, edit, and export videos flexibly from audio files.
- Automatic handling of prompts for export, credits, status, and uploads.
